text: The cohomology operation Sq² (Steenrod square) in synthetic homotopy theory arises from:
choices: symmetry of the join: the flip involution on A*A and its effect on cohomology
explanation: The Steenrod square Sq² can be constructed in HoTT using the cofiber of the fold map ΣA → A * A / flip. This is part of the synthetic approach to stable homotopy operations.
